_comment: The graphs inside smart-base's `L3` named subgraph, declared FROM WITHIN on the pattern of `../L1/graph.json` (owner, 2026-11-13: 'L1..L3 as named subgraphs', issue #359). Each entry is `subgraph: true`, a directory of the LAYER listed by `resolveDirectories` with `within: "smart-base-L3"`. Paths are relative to THIS directory. Declare only what exists.
name: L3

directories.description: Knowledge-graph layer L3, version 3.0: the FHIR conformance and knowledge artefacts an IG publishes (PlanDefinition, ActivityDefinition, Library and its CQL, Measure, Questionnaire, StructureMap, StructureDefinition and profiles, ValueSet, CodeSystem, ConceptMap, ActorDefinition, Requirements), elaborating L2's external artefact. Imports L2-DMN. `l3.ts` is the layer as migrated from WHO smart-kg 3f5e477, typed; `index.ts` exports it to the engine in `../../L1/schemas/`, and `generated/` holds the ontology JSON and the JSON-LD context. The FSH goes to the IG's `input/fsh/`.
The skills that produce L3, the FHIR IG: DAK pre- and post-processing around the IG Publisher, IG artefact ingestion, choosing IG dependencies, and the L3 readiness check. Package `smart-l3`.

The collaborative-development group of L3, OPT-IN inside the opt-in `L3/` and requiring `cat-harness.sdlc`, `L3/` itself and the level below it, whose skills its processes call (owner, 2026-11-13: L2/L3 own collab): the L3 processes that run on the work plan and the delivery process. Only this group requires sdlc; L3's schemas, skills and tools do not. A layer switches it on with `smart-base.L3-collab` in its `enableSubgraphs`.
The L3 tools: the DAK API hub, the IG's Liquid variables and terminology lookup.
